data: Public CryptoDataDownload Bitstamp BTCUSD and ETHUSD daily; only 2015-01-01 through 2025-12-31 completed rows; pre-2015 history may warm up indicators
rule: 20/60/120 close log-momentum positive votes. Flat: enter if >=2 votes; Long: fully exit only if zero positive votes. No top-ups. Reserve max(0.03,3*sample stddev of trailing40 log returns); entry quantity cash/(decisionClose*(1+reserve)*1.0005*1.001), floor 1e-10. Hysteresis holds at one vote.
comparators: ReserveOnly original signals plus adaptive reserve
Peer public-manifest reconstruction if source unavailable
100% buy-and-hold with identical entry time and buy costs
splits: 2015-2019 development descriptive only; 2020,2021,2022 chronological validation annual fresh-capital folds; 2023,2024,2025 frozen holdout annual folds. All years reported; no parameter selection after results.
execution: Decide on close every7 bars; next-close full-order fill or reject if cash insufficient; no clipping or future-based sizing; baseline buys at same first eligible fill with exact affordable quantity; mark both at last close; no forced terminal liquidation
sensitivity: daily decisions and doubled costs; report all, not select winners
metrics: net total return, benchmark excess, daily marked max drawdown, turnover and rejected orders; annual folds not independent trials; no significance claim
limitations: External crypto is a proxy, not the anonymous contest process
Prior full competition outcomes already observed: not a holdout
No tuning on heldout; primary candidate is fixed before any backtest output
Vintage/revision trust in downloaded vendor data cannot be independently guaranteed
